expected_claims.statement: Comets are composed largely of ice and dust and can develop a coma and tails as they approach the Sun, while asteroids are rocky or metallic bodies that do not.
Both comets and asteroids are small bodies left over from the formation of the Solar System.
Most asteroids orbit the Sun in the main asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.
Comets typically travel on more eccentric orbits than main-belt asteroids.
expected_claims.note: Orbital contrast; generally true, subtlety around scattered populations.
